name: animate
title: display:animate
lead: Makes one tweened change of place, scale, rotation or text over `duration` seconds (0.5 by default), played by the client.
signature: display:animate(opts: { at: Vec3 ?, scale: (Vec3 | number)?, rotation: Orientation ?, text: Text ?, color: Ink ?, background: (Ink | false)?, line_width: number ?, shadow: boolean ?, duration: number ?, })

params.name: opts
params.type: { at: Vec3 ?, scale: ( Vec3 | number )?, rotation: Orientation ?, text: Text ?, color: Ink ?, background: ( Ink | false )?, line_width: number ?, shadow: boolean ?, duration: number ?, }

usedIn.quote: Use `display:animate{..., duration = seconds}` for an authored display transition,
